utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: A couple extra tools, right? I can bring those over now if you still need them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, thanks — a couple extra tools would really help. Bring them over when you can, and I’ll put them to use.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey, I may have missed an update, but I still don’t know the full list for the repair drive. If I hear anything, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus — please let me know as soon as you have the date, time, and repair list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Mina — I’ll keep an eye out and bring a couple of tools once you send the details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d still like a clear plan for the repair drive, Tess—what time are we starting, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still gathering the latest on the repair drive, Eli, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I know more. If you can, maybe bring a couple extra tools just in case.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still trying to get the latest list together for the repair drive. Have you heard any updates on what we still need?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven’t heard the latest either—did we get any new volunteers for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an ear out for any updates on the repair drive and let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Faye — thanks. I’ll keep sharing any updates as they come in and send over the repair list once I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — the repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll make sure Cleo has the updated details. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Just send me the updated repair list when you can, and I’ll keep track of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Leo—if you can bring a couple extra tools, that would really help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still waiting on the latest repair list, but I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still waiting on the latest too, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not yet—I’m still trying to pin down exactly what supplies and hands we’re short on for the repair drive. If you hear anything, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I will — I’m still waiting on the updated repair list and time, but I’ll pass along anything I hear as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana—I’m still trying to pin down exactly what supplies and hands we’re short on for the repair drive. If you hear anything useful, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still waiting on the date, time, and finalized repair list before I can help properly. If you get them sorted, please send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I just need the Sunday time and place again—community center, right? Did we get any new volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the community center on Sunday. I’m not sure about new volunteers yet, but I can check and let you know.
